The catalog entry sits under controllerConfig.toolchains (not controller:), carries no command/args, has a 1Gi memory limit, floats, and matches the shape of the eleven entries beside it. Selecting it in a live environment is V19.

items.area: R7 — exactly one stage, named on the command line
items.description: `--stage` is required and single-valued — no default, no 'all stages' — the generator never inspects the branch, and it holds no rule of its own about which stages a repo may publish.
items.rationale: --stage is argparse required=True with no default, no choices and no nargs, so it takes exactly one value; the generator reads no branch (the only git calls are `remote get-url origin` and `rev-parse HEAD`, a commit sha) and holds no list of publishable stages — the one stage literal is release_label's naming rule, copied verbatim from HelmCharts. items.description: The generator is deterministic — regenerating twice over an unchanged checkout produces a byte-identical artifact — and everything it cannot map is printed as its own `gap: <what>` console line with the run staying green.

The gap contract: the real gap prints as its own `gap: <what>` line on stderr and the run exits 0. One residual class stays outside the form, recorded as close-out B6 (nit): a cross-producer ref no producer resolves is printed as `deferred (cross-producer, unresolved): <ref>` — verbatim from HelmCharts under the port-whole ruling — and reaches the artifact bare, where validation rejects it, so it is loud rather than silent. Judged against the bar there, not here.

Live reachability from a running container is V19.

items.area: Owed to the operator — live reachability from a running container
items.description: Owed to the operator, and not earnable in this run: once the image is pushed and the toolchain deployed, `aac-tools` reaches the chart repository and the validation endpoint from a running container — `cexec aac-tools gen-architecture --stage prd …` in a deploy-repo checkout, then `cexec aac-tools arch-validate docs/architecture/<producer>.yaml`. The test phase records this item owed with that command, and never marks it verified off a green build.
items.rationale: Not earnable here and not marked verified: no docker, podman or nerdctl in this pod, and the toolchain reaches an environment only after the operator's pushes and deploy. Everything short of a running container was exercised from source in the iac sidecar (V09, V12, V01): the generator reached charts.home and the dataset, and arch-validate reached the validation service. What stays owed is the same two calls from inside the built image with the homelab root in its trust store. Order (close-out A1): push ArgoCDTools so IaC/ArgoCDTools publishes registry:5000/aac-tools:latest; push and deploy HelmCharts (rolls the prd controller); restart the environment that selects the toolchain. Then, in that environment: git clone /work/KubeCoderDeploy /work/aac-tools-v19 && cd /work/aac-tools-v19 && git remote set-url origin https://github.com/pvginkel/KubeCoderDeploy && cp /work/ArgoCDTools/aac-tools/checks/kubecoder-architecture.yaml architecture.yaml && cexec aac-tools gen-architecture --stage prd --producer kubecoder-deploy && cexec aac-tools arch-validate docs/architecture/kubecoder-deploy.yaml ; cd /work && rm -rf /work/aac-tools-v19. Expected: 'wrote docs/architecture/kubecoder-deploy.yaml — 9 elements, 16 relations', one `gap: kubecoder: image 'kube-coder-tunnel-reclaim' ...` line, then '✓ docs/architecture/kubecoder-deploy.yaml', both exit 0. The clone lives under /work (not /tmp) so the toolchain sidecar sees it; a real deploy repo needs the annotation layer at its root, which KubeCoderDeploy will only carry after slice 014.
